chapter: Los Angeles with Mutt Carey and the taxi dances
title: Returning to Los Angeles; Mutt Carey offers a taxi-dance job
summary: Joe organizes a large dance band in Los Angeles, and Mutt Carey, after Ory's departure, offers him work at the Liberty Dance Hall.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: We organized another band down there in Los Angeles, about a 10-to-12-piece band. And we used to play dances. they had a big dance hall at 15th and Main here, then we played...
That wasn't the One-Eleven Band or whatever it was called.
No, you're talking about a taxi dance. One-Eleven was Tudie's, Ed Garland's band.
Well, was Tudie here when you first came in?
In other words, Ory had left and Tudie stayed.
Yeah, Ory had gone. So Papa Mutt Carey...

Mutt Carey came up to me and asked did I want a job in the taxi dance to play with him. A place called the Liberty Dance Hall. It was a Mexican dance hall. They had a lot of Mexican girls, and a lot of Filipinas used to come in there, too. The taxi dances was a thing...
